dimensions.assessment: Affects federal land management agencies, state Governors, Indian tribes, and counties entering into good neighbor agreements.
dimensions.evidence: The Secretary may enter into a good neighbor agreement with a Governor, Indian tribe, or county... for a term not to exceed 20 years.

dimensions.assessment: Extends agreement timeframes and broadens eligible participants for forest, recreation, and restoration services.
dimensions.evidence: to carry out authorized restoration services in accordance with this section; and for a term not to exceed 20 years.

dimensions.assessment: The source material does not state or imply specific federal spending or revenue changes.
Amends existing statutory provisions in the Agricultural Act of 2014 and the EXPLORE Act regarding forestry and recreation authorities.
dimensions.evidence: To amend the Agricultural Act of 2014 and the EXPLORE Act to provide for long-term Good Neighbor Authority, and for other purposes.

dimensions.assessment: Extends individual project agreements up to 20 years on a permanent statutory basis.
dimensions.evidence: for a term not to exceed 20 years.

missing_information: Estimated volume of federal lands or financial turnover affected by extending agreements to 20 years.
importance_detail.rationale: The bill amends the Agricultural Act of 2014 and the EXPLORE Act to allow Good Neighbor Authority agreements to last up to 20 years and to expand participation eligibility to Indian tribes.

latest_action.text: Referred to the Subcommittee on Forestry and Horticulture.
